caption: A cat digs in a litter box with its front paws, flinging litter backward and leaving a hollow.

sa.check: A cat digs in a litter box with its front paws.
A hollow is left where it digs.
The digging is with the front paws.
The digging comes first and the hollow forms after.

pc.expect: Litter is flung in small showers in the direction of the paw strokes, backward.
pc.fail: It is flung forward; or up and out of the box in a fountain; or no litter moves.

pc.expect: Litter is loose grains that scatter and fall, and the hollow has sloping sides.
pc.fail: It clumps into one mass; or flows like liquid; or the hollow has vertical walls.
It hangs; or rises; or floats.

pc.expect: The hollow forms where the paws dig.
pc.fail: It forms elsewhere; or there is no hollow; or the hollow is there before the digging.

pc.expect: One cat keeps its limbs and shape.
pc.fail: A paw detaches; or a second cat appears; or the cat passes through the box.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The cat's markings and the box stay the same.
pc.fail: The markings change; or the box changes; or the room rearranges.

note: The cat is self-driven: its digging is its own. Only the litter's behaviour is judged.
